messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: QUOTA_ANOMALY P1 - 'Unexpected quota enforcement spike' — 5 services paged. Auto-escalation to oncall immediately.

pagerduty-bot: Paging -> oncall@team-ops (rotation: raj). Alert details: service=quota-mapper severity=critical symptoms=429_throttle_spike

sarah: seeing lots of 429 dashboards spike across regions, also support getting reports. can someone take? :eyes:

raj: acked on PD, i'm on it. grabbing logs now.

maria: i'm inbound if you need a second pair. leaving a note: last rollout of quota-mapper started ~22:12 UTC.

raj: quick check — k8s shows quota-mapper rollout 2->4 replicas at 22:12, but I see a config reconcile that re-applied limits. suspect mapper double-apply bug on rollout.

raj: paste logs for affected tenant sample:
```
[2026-03-14T22:12:07Z] quota-mapper: reconcile start version=2026-03-14-2212 rollout_id=rm-72
[2026-03-14T22:12:07Z] quota-mapper: policy apply tenant=acct-420 previous_limit=100 calculated_limit=10 reason=mapper-rollout
[2026-03-14T22:12:08Z] limiter: enforce tenant=acct-420 limit=10 observed_rps=12 result=429
```

support: customers reporting: 14 distinct accounts, top hit: acme-inc (heavy traffic), beta_co, finserv-labs. Tickets opening now.

dave: checking feature-flag console — quota_mapper_rollout flag toggled ON at 22:11 and a canary config pushed at 22:12. Might be interaction with new reassignment algorithm.

raj: mitigation plan (doing now): 1) disable quota_mapper_rollout feature flag, 2) scale down mapper replicas to stable, 3) add temporary allowlist for high-traffic tenants to bypass new policy. executing step 1.

raj: run: curl -X POST https://admin.internal/flags/quota_mapper_rollout -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"state":"off"}'

deploy-bot: feature flag update accepted (quota_mapper_rollout -> OFF) — change propagated to control plane in 8s.

raj: scaling mapper replicas to previous stable (2).kubectl scale deploy/quota-mapper --replicas=2 -n infra

dave: adding allowlist for top tenants: acme-inc,beta_co,finserv-labs via admin API. command pasted in infra runbook.

raj: after disable + scale + allowlist I'm seeing 429s drop on graphs. rolling window error rate for quota-service down from 18% -> 2% in 3 minutes.

maria: confirm from logs that the apply loop stopped double-applying?

raj: logs now show no 'policy apply' churn. sample:
```
[2026-03-14T22:15:34Z] quota-mapper: reconcile stable version=2026-03-14-2208
[2026-03-14T22:15:34Z] limiter: tenant=acct-420 limit=100 observed_rps=12 result=200
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident auto-escalation paused — all alerts suppressed 10m post-mitigation; manual review required before close.

support: initial customer impact summary: ~14 accounts had transient 429s; we have 6 open support tickets, highest severity impacting 2 enterprise accounts (acme-inc, finserv-labs). No data loss reported.

maria: i'll start an incidents/inc-2134567890 ticket and link runbook + decisions. assign to raj for next steps and postmortem.

raj: handing off to maria in 30m. i'll stay until we confirm full recovery and PD quiet. next steps: root cause triage (double-apply on rollout), reproduce locally, add guard in mapper to prevent overlapping reconciles, add canary throttle.

dave: quick note — we should also add an integration test to catch limit regression on reconcile.

maria: oncall handoff note: current state=stable, mitigation=flag off + replicas scaled + allowlist, customer impact=transient 429s for 14 accounts, remediation=rollback rollout, shall prepare postmortem and action items. I'll own the postmortem doc.

raj: thumbs. leaving timeline and raw logs in the incident doc. paging-bot: mark incident as acknowledged and suppressed.

incident-bot: Incident 2134567890 status=mitigated, escalations suspended. Please follow up in #postmortems once investigation complete. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team. support — please ping me if any new customer escalations come in. i'll close the PD once we confirm no more alerts in 30m.

support: will update tickets and escalate if anything changes.

sarah: huge thanks. when the postmortem is up drop link here and mention action owners. :pray:
